changelog.0.2.0: Add optional peak-grouping (peak_only / peak_neighborhood) non-maximum-suppression stage; off by default
changelog.0.3.0: Emit the thresholded surface on a new cfar_power output port (post-NCI integrated power, or the raw square-law power map when nci_axes is empty); additive, existing ports unchanged
changelog.0.4.0: HSDK 5 Operator<Params> / Graph port with five pooled outputs and single-tick live overrides
changelog.0.5.0: Align the operator with the tick-shell model and add Graph coverage for every scalar live override
changelog.0.6.0: Make all five outputs optional and latch unwired outputs to skip their dedicated publication work
changelog.0.7.0: Represent an unset OS rank with -1 and reject OS configurations that do not supply an explicit rank
changelog.0.8.0: Validate sparse GO/SO and OS K>1 alpha LUTs against the indices reachable by the current map and window
changelog.0.9.0: Freeze pooled output layouts to their contract dtypes so typed downstream consumers are admitted
changelog.1.0.0: Replace peak_only with none, range_doppler, and full N-D all peak modes
changelog.1.1.0: Replace peak_neighborhood with validated per-axis peak_radius
